prompt.zh-CN: 团队让你“给新客服模型做个评测”。你第一个问题应该问什么？
prompt.en-US: The team asks you to “build an eval for the new support model”. What do you ask first?

scenario.zh-CN: 下周要决定是否把它替换掉现网模型。
scenario.en-US: Next week they decide whether it replaces the production model.

text.zh-CN: 这次评测要支撑什么决策、和谁比
text.en-US: What decision the eval informs, and against what baseline

why.zh-CN: 评测是为决策服务的：替换现网就必须和现网模型在同一分布上比较。
why.en-US: An eval serves a decision: replacing production means comparing against the production model on the same distribution.

why.zh-CN: 先选 benchmark 会让评测跟决策脱节，客服流量多半不在任何公开集里。
why.en-US: Picking a benchmark first detaches the eval from the decision; support traffic is rarely in any public set.

why.zh-CN: 资源是约束，不是目标；先定目标再估算预算。
why.en-US: Compute is a constraint, not the goal; settle the goal, then budget.

explanation.zh-CN: 先问决策和基线，再谈数据、指标和资源。
explanation.en-US: Ask about the decision and baseline first; data, metrics and compute follow.

hints.zh-CN: 这份评测结果最后会被谁、用来做什么？
hints.en-US: Who will use the result, and for what?
